claims.quote: Hypsibarbus wetmorei is a cyprinid widespread in mainland Southeast Asia, from the lower Mekong basin south to the Pahang River in Malaysia.

Widespread in mainland Southeast Asia, including the lower Mekong basin in Laos, Thailand, and Cambodia, the Tapi, Chao Phraya and Mae Klong systems in Thailand, and various smaller watersheds in southern Thailand and northern Peninsular Malaysia, as far south as the Pahang River.
